column1: # glossary.tsv - proper-noun glossary for the 天地を喰らう kanji re-conversion
# kind: PERSON, PLACE, ITEM, TITLE, TERM, KEEP. KEEP = katakana/loanword that stays as is (kanji column = kana).
# A kana string listed twice is AMBIGUOUS: use the row whose note lists your @label.
# Compounds not listed are built from the parts: name + さま 様, どの 殿, しょうぐん 将軍, ぐん 軍, じょう 城, のとりで の砦.
# Input defect: reconv_prep.py strips <D5:ド> from table entries, so WORD 22 shows as ミカ (really ミカド = 帝)
#   and NAME C5 shows as ケイウエイ (really ケイドウエイ = 邢道栄). Use the kanji below in both cases.
# Inside tokens, <CALL:21D0=ソウジン> and <CALL:21D4=ソウユウ> are copied byte for byte, never converted; the compiler prints them as 宋仁/宋勇 (kanji pick, tools/kanji_common.py KANJI_CALLS).
# Not a name, but noted: b10_msg_239 おプたそうです is probably a ROM typo for おえた (生涯を終えた); left to the batch owner.
# Glyphs are Izumi16's 16-pixel bitmaps (JF-Dot-Izumi16.ttf).  It lacks only 璝, composed from parts of its bitmaps (tools/kanji_common.py GLYPH_COMPOSE).

column4: Hero lord. Compounds: リュウビぐん 劉備軍, リュウビさま 劉備様, リュウビどの 劉備殿.
劉備's courtesy name (his mother and the Lady use it; b10_msg_129-133).
諸葛亮's courtesy name; the game's officer name. Keep 孔明 wherever the kana says コウメイ.
孔明's elder brother, holds 呉城 (b11_msg_069).
諸葛均, 孔明's younger brother (b10_msg_446 おとうとの キン; b11_msg_139 キンとなのる しょうねん). Given name only, as in the kana.
Sobriquet of 孔明 (b10_msg_335/336/392). 龍 (not 竜) to match 青龍刀 / 子龍.
Sobriquet of 司馬徽. スイキョウせんせい = 水鏡先生.
孔明's friend (孟建) who writes the letter of introduction (b10_msg_333/335). WORD 0C.
孔明's friend; hermitage at 楼桑村 (b10_msg_138, b10_msg_437). Source spelling: katakana サイシュウ + hiragana へ + katakana イ.
Never stands alone: tokenizer fragment of サイシュウへイ (崔州平), split at the hiragana へ.
徐庶's alias (b10_msg_371 ジョショ すなわちタンフクじゃ).
Compounds: ソウソウさま 曹操様, ソウソウぐん 曹操軍.
The game calls him 曹操's じなん (b11_msg_189).
Surname only: ソウいちぞく (b11_msg_118).
In b11_msg_230 (このゲームも おシバイだ) the second おシバイ is a pun on お芝居: keep おシバイ in katakana there; the first シバイ is 司馬懿.
Tokenizer fragment of おーシバイ (b11_msg_192): おー + 司馬懿.
Tokenizer fragment across <PAGENI> in b11_msg_098 (めいどで..グフッ<PAGENI>ソンケンは): keep グフッ, ソンケン = 孫権.
Compounds: トウタクぐん 董卓軍, トウタクしょうこく 董卓相国, トウタクとうばつぐん 董卓討伐軍.
NAME BC/C0/C4 are all 呂布.
b10_msg_261 カクのさくりゃく. NAME 1A, the 董卓-faction strategist (read カク), next to 李傕/郭汜 in the name table. Not 郭嘉 (that is カクカ, NAME 97).
呂布's adoptive father (ようふ, b10_msg_242).
AMBIGUOUS (1 of 2). Yellow Turban, 張角's brother (NAME 0D). Use in @b10_msg_168 @b10_msg_172 @b10_msg_173 @b10_msg_186 @b10_msg_214.
AMBIGUOUS (2 of 2). 張飛's son (NAME AD), joins in the 呉 chapter. Use in @b11_msg_078 @b11_msg_081 @b11_msg_086.
Yellow Turban, 張角's brother (NAME 0E; b10_msg_150/186/214). Not 張遼, who is never named in the dialogue.
AMBIGUOUS (1 of 2). Yellow Turban officer (NAME 38) who knows the secret of the back path to 青州城. Use in @b10_msg_483 @b11_msg_104 @b11_msg_107. For the place 漢中 see the PLACE row.

Lord of 徐州城 (b10_msg_144 ジョシュウじょう トウケンさまの おしろです). He is bedridden (びょうしょう) and offers his castle to 劉備 (b10_msg_153/155), the novel's 三譲徐州. The reading matches 陶謙 exactly, and walkthroughs write 陶謙 too. Rejected 鄒靖/劉焉 (wrong readings) and 鄧賢 (the old draft's choice): 鄧賢 is the 蜀 officer in name-table slot D8 トウケン, which no message uses.
Son of a 徐州 gentleman (陳珪) who offers him as a recruit (b10_msg_179). NAME 3B.
Merchant who funds 劉備 (b10_msg_139). Source spelling: katakana チョウセイ + hiragana へ + katakana イ.
Never stands alone: tokenizer fragment of チョウセイへイ (張世平).
Pirate who joins near 汜水関 (b10_msg_278). An original character from 本宮ひろ志's manga (海賊の周超・王貴・揚謹); fan FC officer lists write 楊謹. The original line reads ヨウキンとというものです (stray と).
蜀 official, 劉備's informant (b10_msg_448, b11_msg_287). NAME 51. Not 張昭 of 呉 (NAME 67, not used in messages).
馬良. In b10_msg_398 馬謖 says あに リョウが なんとうのいおりで まっております, and in b10_msg_399 the man says わたしが バリョウです. Not 諸葛亮 (the old draft's choice).
零陵's champion (b10_msg_422). The game's NAME C5 is ケイドウエイ: reconv_prep.py strips the <D5:ド> token, so the input shows ケイウエイ.
In b11_msg_207 そんしのしょ = 孫子の書.
A girl's pet tiger (b10_msg_408/409/436 わんというなまえなの), a joke on a dog's bark. Keep in hiragana.
袁術's sneer at 関羽 (b10_msg_343/344). WORD 0A.
The dynasty (b10_msg_240 カンのみやこ, b11_msg_101 カンのミカのちをひく, b11_msg_239).
Hiragana in b10_msg_237 (かんのれきし = 漢の歴史).
Compounds: ショクぐん 蜀軍, ショクのくに 蜀の国.
Single katakana (not in the KATA list). Compounds: ギのくに 魏の国, ギずいいち 魏随一.
Single katakana (not in the KATA list). Compounds: ゴのぐん 呉の軍, ゴぐん 呉軍, ゴじょう 呉城.
b11_msg_046 タイギのコウテイ (曹丕 proclaims himself emperor of Great Wei). The hiragana たいぎ in b11_msg_077 is a different word (大義).
b10_msg_401: ４ぐん here means the four commanderies (郡), not armies. b10_msg_421 ４つの ぐん = 四つの郡 too.
Yellow Turban-held, north of 徐州 (b10_msg_150).
Yellow Turban base (張宝). The real 太行山, read たいこうざん. A walkthrough (xneo.jp) writes 大興山.
Game-specific Yellow Turban fortress, a natural stronghold surrounded by mountains on three sides (b10_msg_185), so 峡 (gorge). The xneo.jp walkthrough writes 鉄門境.
劉備's home village (b11_msg_185 ロウソウソンで むしろをうっていた). The game also puts 崔州平's hermitage there (b10_msg_437).
Not in the current text; listed for consistency if needed.
The province of 長安: the castle overlooks 洛陽 and 長安 (b10_msg_256). Not 揚州 (呉). Name-table ヨウシュウ (楊修) is not used.
袁紹 was 渤海太守. WORD 68.
宛 (えん), 袁術's castle in 南陽郡 (b10_msg_303). xneo.jp writes 苑城; 宛 is the historical name.
Hiragana WORD 69 (b10_msg_289 なんようのたいしゅ, b10_msg_349 なんようにも).
Hermit's place near 南陽 (b10_msg_324). The reading matches the famous 陳倉, though the game's geography is its own. xneo.jp also uses 陳倉.
ホクへいのトラ (b10_msg_315) = 趙雲, who came from 公孫瓚's 北平. Source spelling: katakana ホク + hiragana へ + katakana イ.
Never stands alone: fragment of ホクへイ (北平).
Castle in 袁紹's lands where 趙雲 serves (b10_msg_377, b11_msg_168). 広宗 (こうそう) in 冀州 matches the reading; the game's placement is its own.
One of the four 荊州 commanderies (太守 趙範).
AMBIGUOUS (2 of 2). The state threatening 蜀 from outside (張魯's 漢中). Always followed by ぐん: カンチュウぐん = 漢中軍. Use in @b10_msg_448 @b11_msg_007 @b11_msg_017. For the person 韓忠 see the PERSON row.
涪水 (the Fu River; the novel's 涪水関). Castle in 蜀 where 劉璋 is held (b11_msg_002).
Game-specific iron mountain in 蜀 (b11_msg_006/012/019). 剛鉄 = hard iron; xneo.jp also uses 剛鉄山.

呉 region: ハンヨウ fort (b11_msg_072/073/079), ハンヨウざん (the mountain blasted to dam the water, b11_msg_055) and ハンヨウコ (the lake that flooded, b11_msg_050). 鄱陽 (the Han-era spelling is 番陽, read はんよう). Alternative 番陽 uses only common characters.
カイケイのとりで = 会稽の砦.
孫権's castle, held by 諸葛瑾 (b11_msg_069).
呉 commandery (新都郡); xneo.jp also uses 新都城.
Usually read がっぴ; the game writes ガッヒ. ガッヒのとりで = 合肥の砦.
Castle in 魏 nearest 洛陽 (b11_msg_213/224); xneo.jp uses 陳城.
チンリュウのとりで = 陳留の砦.
Read みかど. The game's WORD 22 is ミカド: reconv_prep.py strips the <D5:ド> token, so every ミカ in source_all.txt (21x) is really ミカド. Always 帝. b10_msg_259 ミカをみたど！ = 帝を見たど！
Hiragana in b10_msg_129 (みかどのちをひくみ).
b10_msg_338 ぎてい エンジュツ. WORD 25.
Not in the current text; listed for consistency.
トウタクしょうこく = 董卓相国.
WORD 66. てんさいぐんし = 天才軍師 (b11_msg_226).

column4: 袁術's post in the anti-董卓 alliance (b10_msg_228/268/301/302). Game-specific title, after the kana しょくりょう.
b10_msg_187 こうきんぞくの しゅりょう.
カンチョウのミカ = 漢朝の帝; カンチョウの ふっこう = 漢朝の復興.
The government army (b10_msg_183, a Yellow Turban jeer; b10_msg_228). b11_msg_228 (１００まんのかんぐん, said in 魏) is kept as 官軍 for consistency; 漢軍 is possible there.
WORD 46. とうばつぐん = 討伐軍.

column4: WORD B3. 揚謹 is a pirate; the 青龍刀 comes from pirates.

The five tigers (b10_msg_169 トラとよばれる５にんのぶしょう; b10_msg_244/315/433, b11_msg_007). In b10_msg_348 (トラのいもうとが/トラわれた) the second トラ is a drunk pun on 捕らわれた: keep トラわれた in katakana and convert only the first トラ.
Hiragana for the real pet tiger (b10_msg_436).
WORD D3. The xneo.jp walkthrough uses the same.
Katakana in b11_msg_039; also a stratagem name.
Common noun the game writes in katakana. ぎんのカギ = 銀の鍵.
The source already has the kanji 兵 (b10_msg_061/062/139).
WORD 33. Kept apart from 兵糧 because the kana differs.
Stratagem name (strategy guides: 策免の計).
Stratagem name (strategy guides: 撃免の計).
The back mountain path to 青州城 (b10_msg_481/483) and the path to 鄱陽 (b11_msg_073/075/076). 桟道 is possible.
AMBIGUOUS (1 of 2). Genius: b11_msg_064, b11_msg_219 (てんさいじ 天才児), b11_msg_226 (てんさいぐんし 天才軍師).
AMBIGUOUS (2 of 2). Natural disaster: b11_msg_220 (ありとあらゆる てんさいが つづき).
Era name: けんあん ２６ねん = 建安２６年 (b11_msg_103).
The platform built for 劉備's enthronement (b11_msg_103). No fixed term; 大礼台 is the most natural reading.
b11_msg_112 ショクの めいかたなしにあったか？ Likely a shortened めいかたなかじ; 名刀師 keeps the kana.
b10_msg_227 ここは コロウカン ていけんの ようさいです. Unclear: possibly a misprint for てんけん (天険, natural stronghold). Keep in kana unless the batch owner decides otherwise.
ITEM 19. 王允's heirloom that 呂布 wants. めいけん = 名剣.
ITEM 4E. Do not confuse with ばくやく (爆薬).
ITEM 4F. 青釭 is the novel's sword of 曹操; xneo.jp writes 青紅.
ITEM 50. 屠龍 = dragon-slaying. xneo.jp writes 土龍, but 土竜 means "mole" in Japanese, so it was rejected.
ITEM 51. The game's word is せいりゅうとう, so 青龍刀 (not 青龍偃月刀).
Tokenizer fragment of きゃーエッチ！ (b10_msg_276): keep as is.
Foreign place name in the quiz joke (b10_msg_425): keep in katakana.
Part of カクカク シカジカ (= かくかくしかじか); keep in katakana. Not 賈詡.
Loanword. The source uses hiragana べ because the font has no katakana ベ; copy it exactly.
Katakana sentence-final particle in b11_msg_166 (のですネ); keep.
Stammer in b11_msg_238 (ソ---ソウソウさま → ソ---曹操様).
Hiragana loanword in b11_msg_025; keep as written.
Hiragana loanword in the save menu (b11_msg_151/152); keep as written.
